entryPointReview: The exact final focused-test bytes (SHA-256 dcec57abcfa0eac7964a340fbf32f7f4c785a194eadaddd2f19c67b05f1bba68) and command were paired once against the assignment-base dog.js bytes and once against the repaired dog.js bytes. The final test freeze was made after the first production draft: it corrected the observer from after.gridOwns to after.actor.gridOwns and added explicit invalid offmap/onmap admission controls. The earlier initial red, first code draft, and first green observer failure remain preserved separately in the task cache; this final red is not represented as pre-first-edit. The red demonstrates the exact ordinary f585 failed-arrival lifecycle losing its actor from the migration list and retaining flags/tracks/destination inconsistently, with 457 default RNG calls; the same bytes pass after the narrow source repair. This is focused JS source-parity evidence only, not C gameplay/public-parity or certification.

functions.name: losedogs
functions.sourceReview: C dog.c losedogs403-415 pops each actual failed_arrival, re-adds it to fmon and invokes mon.m_into_limbo. C mon.c3834-3865 sets LIMBO and specifically admits mx0 failed arrivals through migrate_mon, skipping map-dependent unstuck/specialdrop prefix, then migrate_to_level. Current JS readds then records a marker; its existing migration helper also rejects mx0 at m_at identity guard. Actual f585 reached the real default failure after350 canonical boulders, zero legal goodpos backup and457 additional RNG calls; actor37 left in level[37,7] at0,0/no grid, flags0, zeroed tracks, bad mux/muy40,14, no migrant. This is not Wizard/keepdogs or old elemental-clog evidence. At the exact whole losedogs failed_arrivals loop, preserve pop/re-add order and await existing m_into_limbo(monster,state,env). Import the existing helper from mon.js. In migrate_to_level preserve current on-map identity validation; admit only the source-valid off-map failed-arrival state mx===0, linked current level-list actor, MON_LIMBO set by canonical wrapper, valid track. Keep all current shop/worm/disguise/stuck/coordinate/track/other guards and exact mon_leave→await relmon→MIGRATING→track/destination/mxmy order. Existing levelMonsterPredecessor may validate list ownership without mutation. No blanket mx0 bypass, placement, map synthesis or helper/API expansion. Same actor must return to gm.migrating_mons only, LIMBO|MIGRATING and not STILL_ARRIVING, MIGR_APPROX_XY, track1 old0,0, track2 currentlevel, mux/muy currentlevel, mxmy0, mlstmv currentmoves, no grid, failedlist drained and other level actor unchanged. No new RNG or input/placement attempt.
